tips.text: Type / to browse every slash command
Type @ to attach a file; Tab inserts the top match
Mention several @files in one prompt for wider context
Type $ to put one of your installed skills to work
Don't like something? Change it with $extension-builder
Start a line with ! to run a shell command
Type :name to message a running sub-agent or teammate
Type ? on an empty prompt to list every shortcut
Press Shift+Tab to cycle edit, plan, auto and YOLO modes
Press Shift+Enter while autohand works to steer it
Press Shift+Enter or Alt+Enter to add a new line
Press Tab to accept the suggested next prompt
Press Esc to interrupt the running turn
Press Ctrl+C once to clear input, twice to exit
Press ↑ or ↓ to recall messages you typed earlier
Press Ctrl+O to expand command output
Press Ctrl+T to toggle the team panel
Press Ctrl+G to toggle the goals panel
Type /goal to set an objective autohand keeps at
Type /goals to watch and manage the live goals queue
Type /skills to discover and install project skills
Type /skills use to activate an installed skill
Type /skills search to find community skills
Type /learn to get skill ideas for this project
Type /memory to save notes autohand recalls later
Type /sessions to list past work, /resume to continue
Type /rename so /sessions shows what this is about
Type /fork to branch from an earlier message
Type /clone to duplicate this session branch
Type /tree to see this project's fork and clone tree
Type /new to start fresh; the session is saved first
Type /clear to reset context and keep a memory summary
Type /export to save this session's transcript
Type /whatityped to reuse a message from any folder
Type /agents to watch sub-agents working in parallel
Type /agents new to create a specialist sub-agent
Type /team to put a team of agents on one task
Type /tasks to see team tasks with status and owners
Type /message to send a teammate a direct note
Type /peers to see other sessions in this workspace
Type /review to check your changes before shipping
Type /pr-review to review a diff or pull request
Type /tester to run tests and capture real evidence
Type /deslop to cut generated complexity safely
Type /plan to break a complex task into steps
Type /undo to revert the last change autohand made
Type /mcp to manage MCP servers and their tools
Type /hooks to run your own commands on agent events
Type /extensions to install and manage extensions
Type /import to bring in data from other coding agents
Type /add-dir to let autohand work in another folder
Type /permissions to see what autohand may do
Type /ide to connect a running IDE
Type /model to switch model and reasoning effort
Type /usage to see plan limits and token activity
Type /settings to tune autohand, idle tips included
Type /statusline to configure the composer status line
Type /theme to change the terminal color theme
Type /language to switch the display language
Type /cc to toggle context compaction on or off
Type /yolo to auto-approve every action
Type /init to write an AGENTS.md for this project
Type /deep-research to research and save a cited report
Type /autoresearch to run edit and benchmark loops
Type /repeat to schedule a prompt at a fixed interval
Type /ps and /stop to manage background shell jobs
Type /tools to inspect and manage saved meta-tools
Type /experiments to try features before they ship
Type /whatsnew to catch up on new CLI features
Type /feedback to send the team a bug or idea
Type /upgrade to see what the next plan unlocks
Type /handoff web to continue this chat in a browser
Type /go to pair this session with the iOS app
Type /squad to open the local Autohand Squad runtime
Type /search to choose your web search provider
Try ${{skill}}: {{description}}
Type ${{skill}} to put that skill to work
Type {{command}} to {{description}}
